title: DSWD to suspend AICS guarantee letters; cash aid continues

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) will temporarily stop issuing guarantee letters (GLs) under its Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) program starting Nov. 30, but will continue accepting people seeking outright cash assistance through its offices nationwide.
